change_control.review_note: German Working Holiday baseline verified against the current Embassy of Japan in Germany Working Holiday guidance and FAQ.

summary_facts.label: Participation
summary_facts.value: Up to two Working Holiday stays in a lifetime

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: €2,000 with outbound+return tickets; €3,200 with outbound ticket only

eligibility_rules.label: Do you hold a German passport?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The German Working Holiday route is available only to applicants with a German passport.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The German Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The main purpose must be a holiday in Japan; temporary work is incidental.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependent family members rely on your Working Holiday route?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Accompanying dependants are not eligible for an additional family visa under this route.

eligibility_rules.label: Will your German passport be valid for the application and travel?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: A valid German passport is required.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the programme's good-health requirement?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Working Holiday programme includes a good-health requirement.

funds_rule.no_ticket_note: The €3,200 figure applies when only an outbound ticket is submitted. If no flight ticket is submitted, the Embassy requires €3,200 plus at least the amount of a one-way ticket.

jurisdiction.label: Japanese Embassy or Consulate-General in Germany
jurisdiction.description: German passport holders may apply even if they do not reside in Germany, but the Working Holiday application itself must be lodged at a Japanese diplomatic mission in Germany.

document_checklist.title: German passport
document_checklist.description: Valid German passport; follow the chosen mission's instructions for original/copy handling.

document_checklist.title: Visa application form and current photo
document_checklist.description: Complete the current visa application form and provide the required recent passport photograph.

document_checklist.title: Detailed proposed itinerary
document_checklist.description: Provide concrete intended places and activities; generic entries such as only 'work' or 'travel' are not sufficient.

document_checklist.title: CV
document_checklist.description: CV in English or Japanese; an individually created format is acceptable.

document_checklist.title: One-page motivation letter
document_checklist.description: Provide a motivation letter in English or Japanese explaining the Working Holiday purpose.

document_checklist.title: Proof of funds
document_checklist.description: Current bank statement meeting the applicable €2,000 / €3,200 baseline and current official flight-evidence rule.

document_checklist.title: Travel health insurance evidence or National Health Insurance pledge
document_checklist.description: Provide the insurance evidence or pledge permitted by the current official guidance.

document_checklist.title: Proof first stay ended (second application only)
document_checklist.description: For a second Working Holiday application, provide evidence that the first stay has ended or is no longer valid.

preparation_checklist.title: Read the current German official guidance
preparation_checklist.description: Re-open the Embassy/Consulate guidance immediately before preparing your application.

preparation_checklist.title: Choose the Japanese mission in Germany
preparation_checklist.description: The Working Holiday application must be made through a Japanese diplomatic mission in Germany; local submission procedures vary.

preparation_checklist.title: Align funds with your flight evidence
preparation_checklist.description: The required funds differ depending on whether you show return, outbound-only or no flight tickets.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final source check
preparation_checklist.description: Compare your pack with the exact current instructions of the mission where you will apply.
